parameters.name: AddInstanceList
parameters.description: The list of instances to add in this rule update. If no instances need to be added, you do not need to specify this parameter.

sub_parameters.name: InstanceId
sub_parameters.description: The instance ID of the asset.

sub_parameters.name: RegionId
sub_parameters.description: The region ID of the asset.

parameters.name: DeleteInstanceList
parameters.description: The list of instances to delete in this rule update. If no instances need to be deleted, you do not need to specify this parameter.

sub_parameters.name: InstanceId
sub_parameters.description: The instance ID of the asset.

sub_parameters.name: RegionId
sub_parameters.description: The region ID of the asset.

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description:
The rule ID.
> You can call the [ListCheckRule](~~2590599~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: RuleType
parameters.description:
The rule type. Default value: **WHITE**. Valid values:
- **WHITE**: whitelist.

parameters.name: ScopeType
parameters.description:
The scope of the rule. Valid values:
- **INSTNACE**: instance
- **ITEM**: check item.
